content.title: Seniors se baat?
content.subtitle: Sahi tareeke se poochoge toh jawab bhi milega.

steps.title: Sahi platform
steps.detail: LinkedIn ya university ke student groups. Unka course aur city pehle check karo.

steps.title: Chhota intro
steps.detail: Naam, aapka course aur ek line mein kyun message kar rahe ho.

steps.title: Specific sawaal
steps.detail: Sab kuch batao mat poocho. Rent, classes ya city ke baare mein ek do sawaal.

steps.title: Unka time respect karo
steps.detail: Jawab late aaye toh chalta hai. Baar baar message mat bhejo.

steps.title: Shukriya kaho
steps.detail: Jawab mila toh thank you. Baad mein aap bhi kisi junior ki madad karna.

caption:
Seniors se baat karna sabse acchi research hai. Bas tareeka sahi ho 👇

1. Sahi platform
2. Chhota intro

5. Shukriya kaho

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jise iski zaroorat hai.
